correctness.rationale: The repair restricts to the sharp numerical fertility and mortality profiles, with positive reproductive mass and a uniform mortality lower bound h. At the prey-only state the predator is autonomous to first order, with replacement integral R. A real positive characteristic root proves invasion above one, and the exponentially weighted Volterra convolution plus prey variation of constants proves exponential decay below one. Shifting adult age to s removes T from fertility and extracts exp(-g*xbar*T). Since cumulative baseline mortality is nondecreasing, Q(T2,k) <= exp(-h(T2-T1))*Q(T1,k). Positivity, continuity and decay imply a unique positive age crossing precisely when Q(0,k)>1, and give the explicit upper bound. The logarithmic g-threshold decreases where T>0 and Q>1. No finite-steepness age conclusion or global nonlinear extinction is asserted. The frozen numerical script was inspected, not executed, and is unnecessary for the repaired analytic proof.
